question: A genetically modified form of brinjal was developed. What was its purpose?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Making it insect-resistant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A genetically modified form of brinjal was developed with the purpose of **making it insect-resistant**.
 
• This modification helps in reducing the damage caused by insects, thereby leading to better yield and reduced need for chemical pesticides.
